description: A modular, stack-agnostic toolkit for AI coding agents to autonomously find, reproduce, and patch vulnerabilities.

written.description: Reads a codebase and its commit history, builds a threat model from them, and sends agents to chase each hypothesis it raises. It then tries to reproduce each finding in a sandbox and attacks its own patch to check the fix holds, working from source alone with no running target.

alive.last_commit_message:
Let a scan leave parts of its target out

A scan of a directory had no way to skip a subdirectory: vendored code,
generated files, and test fixtures were swept, ranked, and listed with
everything else. --exclude takes patterns relative to the target, repeats,
and accepts comma-separated lists; a workflow can carry the same list as
config.exclude and the flag adds to it. A bare name matches a directory or
file of that name at any depth, a pattern with a slash matches the relative
path, fnmatch wildcards apply, and a match on a directory covers what is
under it.

Exclusion governs what is scanned, not what exists. Excluded files are left
out of discovery (so file-by-file and auto never make campaigns of them),
out of the surveyor's groups (so cross-functional never ranks them; the
snapshot id is computed over what remains), and out of the agent's listing
(so a whole-target campaign is not steered into them). They stay readable
and stay in the structural index: a scanned function that calls into an
excluded directory can still be followed there, and a caller in an excluded
test directory is still a caller. The run prints what it excluded and how
many files remain in scope, and a target that excludes everything is an
error rather than a scan of nothing.

The matcher lives in core/exclusions.py with the patterns' semantics, and
the three consumers each take the list explicitly: discover_files(),
survey(), and RunContext.exclude for list_files. The vetted-staging call in
the surveyor is unchanged; the filter runs on its result.

Fixes https://github.com/google/mantis/issues/11

Change-Id: Id979123a49943e85c49fbc1f4855e0df4628a895
